name: Wave Runner
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Native port of the Waveform Builder rendering engine. Same visual concept as the WebView TopVis visualiser, but rendered through Skia via the PluginCanvas API — used to A/B-test whether bypassing the WebView gives meaningful headroom on mobile. Currently hard-codes a single bars layer with frequency-mapped colours; the goal is render-loop speed, not config flexibility.
